Trying to get some math.

```{ojs}
fetchData()
```

```{ojs}
async function fetchData() {
  try {
    const response = await fetch('https://discourse.marksmath.org/t/13.json');

    // Check if the response status is within the success range (200-299)
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
    }

    const json = await response.json();
    const posts = json.post_stream.posts;
    console.log(posts);
    const cooked = posts[1].cooked;
    const div = d3.create('div');
    div.html(cooked);
    div.selectAll('span.math')
      .nodes()
      .forEach(function(span) {
        const d3Span = d3.select(span);
        const new_content = katex.render(d3Span.html(), d3Span.node())
      });
    div.selectAll('div.math')
      .nodes()
      .forEach(function(Div) {
        const d3Div = d3.select(Div);
        const new_content = katex.render(
          d3Div.html(), 
          d3Div.node(),
          {displayMode: true}
        )
      });
    return div.node()
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching data:', error);
  }
}
```
